refresh_rule: Live on open: this page fetches fresh state every time it opens (tap = current state), cache-busted. State also rebuilds on every team change and every 5 min by schedule. AUTO-DISCOVERY: new D-files, kernel versions, run dirs, cron jobs, work dirs and deliverables are found by scan and appear as nodes within one refresh cycle (5 min) of starting — on every tap after that refresh. Never second-by-second, never a hand rebuild. No animated fake motion.
honesty: Every node is an AI agent, specialist or tool — not a human employee. Every state traces to a real file named in the node. No activity is animated or invented. Off-box activity leaves no box file: Muse updates team_status.json the moment an outside brain is consulted or assigned, so those nodes appear via the same refresh. Outside-brain assignment fields show the standing reply route (reply → Muse MD/CTO → named internal specialist lane → our engine; sanitized design review only, never auto-applied).
